يحتازوا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَازُوا (yaḥtāzū) /jaħ.taː.zuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَازَ (iḥtāza)
# يُحْتَازُوا (yuḥtāzū) /juħ.taː.zuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَازَ (iḥtāza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
